Title: Add two integer numbers and display the result
Preconditions: Two integer numbers are available for addition
Steps:
1. Enter the first integer number. 2. Enter the second integer number. 3. Select the addition operation.

Test Data: 10, 15
Expected Result: The result of the addition is displayed as 25

Title: Subtract two integer numbers and display the result
Preconditions: Two integer numbers are available for subtraction
Steps:
1. Enter the first integer number. 2. Enter the second integer number. 3. Select the subtraction operation.

Test Data: 25, 10
Expected Result: The result of the subtraction is displayed as 15

Title: Multiply two integer numbers and display the result
Preconditions: Two integer numbers are available for multiplication
Steps:
1. Enter the first integer number. 2. Enter the second integer number. 3. Select the multiplication operation.

Test Data: 10, 10
Expected Result: The result of the multiplication is displayed as 100

Title: Divide two integer numbers and display the result
Preconditions: Two integer numbers are available for division, with the second number not being zero
Steps:
1. Enter the first integer number. 2. Enter the second integer number. 3. Select the division operation.

Test Data: 20, 5
Expected Result: The result of the division is displayed as 4

Title: Handle division by zero with integer number input
Preconditions: Two integer numbers are available for division, with the second number being zero
Steps:
1. Enter the first integer number. 2. Enter zero as the second integer number. 3. Select the division operation.

Test Data: 10, 0
Expected Result: An error message is displayed indicating that division by zero is not allowed
